OpsBot: :rotating_light: INCIDENT ALERT — SmartRouting evaluator error spike. economy tier in eu-west returning 429s, 5m error rate ~7%, ~1k 429s in last 10m. Pager fired. @oncall please ACK.
Maya K.: Acked. I'm on call. Quick triage: which customers report errors and any obvious config changes in last hour?
Devon T.: looking at metrics now. Most of the 429s correlate with economy-tier traffic in eu-west; policy eval latency jumps right before 429 bursts. No deploys in last hour. 
Samir P.: hmm could be policy evaluator KV contention — we've seen similar when prefix cache churns under heavy small-request loads.
Maya K.: OK mitigation plan: 1) immediately reduce economy tier weight in eu-west to shed load, 2) apply temporary per-customer soft quotas for top noisy tenants, 3) disable economy-prefetch caching for affected hosts to avoid KV thrash. Can we do 1 now?
Devon T.: Doing step 1. Running dry-run then apply.
Devon T.: ```
# dry-run
redwoodctl routing adjust --region eu-west --policy smart-routing-v2 --tier economy --weight 0.2 --dry-run
# apply
redwoodctl routing adjust --region eu-west --policy smart-routing-v2 --tier economy --weight 0.2 --apply
```
Devon T.: Applied. weight 0.60 -> 0.20. Traffic rerouted to standard/priority lanes accordingly.
Maya K.: Metrics: 429s dropping from ~1000 to ~320 in last 2m. Latency for priority lanes increased slightly but within SLA. Good.
Samir P.: I'll flip cache prefetch off for economy hosts in eu-west to see if evaluator latency normalizes.
Samir P.: ```
# toggle cache prefetch
redwoodctl feature toggle --region eu-west --feature economy-prefetch --state off --reason "mitigate KV churn"
```
Samir P.: Done. Watching.
Lina S.: Suggest soft quotas on top noisy customers — reduces burstiness while we fix evaluator. I can push per-customer rate-limits; want a conservative cap to avoid breaking UX: 30 req/min for customers above 95th percentile.
Maya K.: Go ahead, apply to these customers: acme-corp, beta-inc, and faststart. Use soft quota (429s surfaced as 429-warning header) so SDKs can backoff gracefully.
Lina S.: ```
# per-customer soft quota (eu-west)
redwoodctl quotas set --customer acme-corp --region eu-west --rps 0.5 --soft --note "mitigate smart-routing spike"
redwoodctl quotas set --customer beta-inc --region eu-west --rps 0.5 --soft
redwoodctl quotas set --customer faststart --region eu-west --rps 0.5 --soft
```
Lina S.: Applied. Customers should see warning 429s; CS informed to expect support pings.
Maya K.: Customer impact summary for postmortem: transient 429s for economy-tier customers in eu-west; approximately 12 customers saw >5% error rates, we applied temporary quotas and weight reduction. No priority-tier customer SLA breaches.
Devon T.: Observability note: increased evaluator latency traces show frequent KV cache misses and a spike in backend DB reads at the policy evaluator. Candidate root cause: stale cache eviction timing + sudden small-request workload burst.
EngRuntimeBot: New deploy created for evaluator patch: branch fix/eval-cache-stabilize, will run canary 10% eu-west in 5m.
Maya K.: Can we run canary behind the temporary mitigations? I prefer canary route to go to fenced capacity so we don't reintroduce the surge.
Samir P.: Canary plan: route 10% of priority/standard to patched evaluator in eu-west, but keep economy routed to stable variant until we confirm KV behavior. Command:

```
redwoodctl routing rollout --region eu-west --service evaluator --version fix/eval-cache-stabilize --percent 10 --target-lanes priority,standard
```

Samir P.: Canary started.
Devon T.: After cache prefetch off and weight drop, evaluator 5m latency back to baseline, DB read rate dropped ~60%. 429s now ~80/min steady.
Maya K.: Great. Next steps: keep mitigations for 30m while canary runs; if canary stable for 15m, gradually lift economy weight to 0.4 then 0.6 over controlled windows. Ops: notify CS and SRE shifts.
Lina S.: Notifying CS now. Sending templated message with impacted customer list and mitigation summary.
Maya K.: Logging runbook steps and tagging incident for postmortem. I'll hand off to morning shift at 08:00 UTC. Oncall rotation: please monitor until then and escalate to eng-runtime if canary shows regressions.
Devon T.: Confirm monitoring alert thresholds adjusted to ignore transient warning 429s from soft quotas (so we don't noise the paging system).
Samir P.: Will follow up with post-deploy metrics and a small dashboard (latency, 429s, DB reads, cache hit rate) for eng-runtime.
OpsBot: Incident update saved to ticket INC-174900. Handoff note added: mitigations active (economy weight lowered, prefetch off, per-customer soft quotas). No customer data lost. Engineering patch in canary. :white_check_mark:
Maya K.: Thanks all. If canary holds, we'll plan a controlled rollout + rollback plan and remove soft quotas after 2 hours. Leaving channel open for 2h then archiving. Good job.
